mentions.name: My Financé
mentions.description: This is a personal finance tool focused on planning and forecasting, aimed at people who want to quit their jobs. It includes a rudimentary planning and forecasting engine and syncs accounts via Plaid; the builder is exploring a fully local-first design so the service would not need access to users' data.
mentions.problem: The builder struggled to find traction, so the tool is being niched down to help people who want to quit their jobs plan the financial transition.
mentions.audience: People who want to quit their jobs
mentions.source_excerpt: I continue to work on My Financé, my personal finance tool.

mentions.name: My Financé
mentions.description: A personal finance tool featuring a simulation engine that lets users forecast their spending and build life scenarios (like taking a year off, getting a cat, or moving to a new city) based on their current spending patterns and assets.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m still working on My Financé (I keep getting feedback this name is confusing), which is a fairly undifferentiated personal finance tool.
